entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The storybook world of fairy-tale wonder and danger, lying under a curse.

entities.name: Wilds
entities.description: The darker region beyond the Realm of Eldraine, filled with fairy-tale wonder and danger.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch who, with her sisters and Talion, is responsible for the curse over the land.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: A Fae Lord responsible for the curse who tasks a young human with fae blood with vanquishing the three witch sisters.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: The curse over the land from which nobody can wake.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker who takes up his father's sword and seeks peace to fix his home.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Will's twin sister, a Strixhaven-trained mage who thinks she can gain enough magical power to restore things.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A non-desparked planeswalker who arrives to profit from the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young human with fae blood tasked by Talion to vanquish the three witch sisters.

events.summary: Eriette, her sisters and Talion are responsible for a curse over Eldraine while others vie for power.
